info.title: Zscaler Private Access API Portal
info.description: To access detailed ZPA API documentation, including references and use cases, refer to the [Zscaler Help Portal](/zpa/about-zpa-api).

get.summary: Gets the ZPA Private Service Edge group details for the specified ID.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

parameters.name: serviceEdgeGroupId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ZPA Private Service Edge group.

parameters.name: microtenantId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained in the API Keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations are limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant.

upgradePriority.description: The upgrade priority for the ZPA Private Service Edge. This field is only applicable for GET requests, and is ignored in POST, PUT, and DELETE requests.

upgradeTimeInSecs.description: Indicates the time in seconds that the Private Service Edges in this group attempt to update to a newer version of the software.

upgradeDay.description: Indicates the day the ZPA Private Service Edges in this group attempt to update to a newer version of the software.

graceDistanceEnabled.description: If enabled, allows ZPA Private Service Edge groups within the specified distance to be prioritized over a closer ZPA Public Service Edge. To learn more, see Configuring Redirection Policies Using API.

graceDistanceValue.description: Indicates the maximum distance in miles or kilometers to ZPA Private Service Edge groups that would override a ZPA Public Service Edge. To learn more, see Configuring Redirection Policies Using API.

graceDistanceValueUnit.description: Indicates the grace distance unit of measure in miles or kilometers. This value is only required if graceDistanceEnabled is set to true. To learn more, see Configuring Redirection Policies Using API.
